samples.question: The six discs above the grey rule are the starting row. Below the rule are four more rows, numbered 1 to 4 from the top. Every row holds the same six colours in some order, in six places numbered 1 to 6 from the left. Do this twelve times to the starting row: swap the red disc with the disc in the next place to its right, counting on past place 6 back to place 1; then move the disc in place 6 to place 1 and slide the other five discs one place to the right. Together with the starting row that gives thirteen rows. Three of the four numbered rows are among those thirteen and one of them never is. Which numbered row never appears? Answer with the row number alone: 1, 2, 3, or 4.
